breast milk from women vaccinated against SARS COV 2 contains specific anti Sars CoV 2 S1 IgG antibodies, and these levels increase considerably after the second dose, with a positive correlation between breast milk and blood IgG(S1).

the detection of SARS CoV2 IgG antibodies in breast milk and serum samples from lactating women vaccinated against COVID 19 with an mRNA vaccine, as well as their correlation across time.

the vaccine is safe and effective for lactating women.
